facts: addFreshEntity delegates private addEntity and returns its boolean.
addEntity rejects already-removed entities, returns false when entity-manager insertion fails, and returns true after successful insertion and normal completion of onAddedToLevel.
Exceptions from native callbacks can occur after partial world effects; a successful-return witness cannot be inferred from attempted insertion.
